en: so a few hundred AI agents did most of the hacking on their own and hit 395 orgs across 48 countries… half of them schools 😳 meanwhile the US Senate opened a probe into OpenAI's agents going rogue. less "AI got smarter", more "AI just does stuff now" #AInews
